title: sessions: Gate new-session pulse on onboarding experiment
body:
## Summary
The New Session button could pulse for eligible new users even when its onboarding experiment was inactive or assigned to control. Only the subsequent tour was experiment-gated.

- Gate the pulse through the onboarding service using the existing experiment (`onb.newSession.show` and `onb.newSession.id`).
- Respect the global onboarding switch, context and shown-state checks, preserving the explicit developer-mode override.
- Record the would-show moment in both experiment arms before the nudge can affect behavior.
- Add regression coverage for experiment eligibility, developer mode, onboarding disablement, visibility delay and click behavior.

## Validation
- TypeScript syntax checks passed for all five changed files using the editor-bundled compiler.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- Client compile, lint and focused unit tests could not run: this checkout lacks Node/npm on PATH, dependencies and compiled output. CI validation is required.
